$comment: Public website pages that text outside the website links to: the inbound-mail bounce text (contracts/inbound-mail-contract.json, the German paths) and the app's help links (apps/workspace/shared/public-site.ts). Paths only; the origin is configuration, LANDING_URL (https://<webDomain>), never written here. Each key is a key of ROUTES in apps/website/src/i18n/paths.ts and each `anchors` entry a section id of that page in both locales; apps/website/src/i18n/public-site.test.ts holds the website to this file, so a moved page fails a test rather than a sender's bounce. Paths are the site's URLs: copy, not identifiers.
